 Subject: AT-WILL DISCLAIMER, POLICY — Approved:
REVISIONS, REFERENCES TO GENDER
 Issued: April 2007
 Revised: 6/2021, 10/2025
 PURPOSE: To clarify employment terms, how policy revisions are communicated, and to
clarify references to gender. PROCEDURE:
1. AT WILL DISCLAIMER
 A. St. Mary's does not guarantee that any employee will be employed permanenily or for a
specific length of time. This manual is nota contract of employment. B. All St. Mary’s employees are employed “at will.” This means that St. Mary’s may
terminate employment at any time, with or without cause and with or without notice. C. This also means that the employee may volu ntarily resign at any time, with or without
notice, except that a failure to give notice upon resigning voluntarily may have adverse
effects, as described in the “Termination” section of this manual. 2. REVISIONS TO THIS MANUAL:
 A. St. Mary's reserves the right to change the terms of this manual, and its application, with
or without notice to employees. B.

staff on our HRIS system. All employees will be required to review and acknowledge
electronically and will be on file in the Human Resources Department. The complete HR
policy manual will be maintained on the intemal company website. 3. REFERENCES TO GENDER:
All references in the HR Policies to one gender shall be considered a reference to both
genders, unless the context clearly indicates otherwise.
